newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Flight Centre sees strong growth.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Flight Centre sees strong growth.

text.p: Discount flight operator Flight Centre Ltd said on Thursday it saw growth continuing in the current year but not at the same rate as achieved in the latest year to June 30, 1996.
"We still see growth continuing but we won't see the same rate of profit growth as in 95/96," chief executive officer Graham Turner told a news conference.
"If we can achieve the same growth in shop numbers, profit and turnover of 20 to 25 percent we'll be happy," Turner said.
Turner said the group which earlier reported a 55 percent increase in net profit to A$11.85 million hoped to open 60 more shops in the current year both locally and internationally.
"We are investing our funds in South Africa, the U.K. and Canada where we have been for the last year," Turner said.
Finance Director Jim Goldburg said the group "at this point can fund our expansion from profits".
Chairman Norm Fussell said the group would be looking at growth continuing in the current year "both in sales and in profits".
